_README: 9.9 multilingual parity gate: the ten questions here are es/de/fr renderings of ten cases in eval_cases_retrieval.json (`english` holds the original, ignored by eval.py). Each expects the SAME document and the same cited pages as the English original's three no-grade runs on 2026-10-01 (`expected_page` = union of the English top source's pages). Run: python eval.py --cases eval_cases_multilingual.json --repeats 3 --no-grade. Measure-only: no baseline, no grading (keywords are digits and codes only, since the answer comes back translated).

cases.q: ¿Qué tamaño de tornillos necesito para montar el MyCheckr y cuántos orificios de montaje tiene?
